messages:
miguel: FYI -- ALB started deregistering targets from the east-2 GPU pool ~10m ago. App readiness probe latency spiked from ~120ms to multiple seconds and then targets drop. Alert: https://grafana.redwood/alert/ALB-Target-Deregister
infra-bot: [ALERT] alb-targets-down (east-2/gpu-pool) — 24 targets unhealthy, 18 deregistered in 10m :rotating_light:
sarah: Is this AZ-wide or just one node group? Any recent kube-proxy or CNI rollouts?
miguel: Appears concentrated on the gpu-scaleup ASG. Pods show repeated readiness failures. kube events show lots of "Readiness probe failed". Sample from one pod:
```
Liveness:   http-get http://:8080/health delay=10s timeout=1s period=10s #0
Last Probe: 2026-02-28T15:23:10Z - failed, reason: HTTP probe failed, statusCode=504
Events:
  Warning  Unhealthy  2m  kubelet  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 504
```
raj: 504s from the probe likely mean the healthcheck couldn't reach the pod quickly. Could be SNAT port exhaustion or egress NAT rebalance at the same time as scale-up. Any NAT gateway scaling events?
elaine: I pulled VPC logs, saw NAT gateway scale activity at roughly the same time: 
```
[2026-02-28T15:21:43Z] natgw: allocate_ports: ephemeral_port_pool_exhausted threshold=0.92
[2026-02-28T15:22:01Z] natgw: scale_event: creating 1 additional natgw
```

miguel: Also seeing a spike in conntrack counters on the nodes: "conntrack entries ~125k" (we're on a 128k limit). On nodes that lost targets, conntrack_lookup timed out in iptables logs.
oncall-marc: Did anything change to the ALB healthcheck config? timeout/interval?
miguel: No config changes. Healthcheck is 10s interval, 5s timeout, healthy threshold 2. ALB logs show repeated 504 responses proxied to targets then target deregistration after consecutive failures. Snippet: 
```
ELB-HealthChecker: 2026-02-28T15:23:12Z targetResponse=504 target=fip-10-0-2-45
ELB-HealthChecker: 2026-02-28T15:23:22Z targetResponse=504 target=fip-10-0-2-45
```
raj: Sounds like a classic ephemeral port / SNAT collision during a burst of outbound connections (model downloads, metrics, or sidecar egress). When NAT port pool gets tight, new outbound flows get queued and healthchecks get delayed. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase node source port range / reduce conntrack timeout, 2) reduce ALB sensitivity by upping healthy threshold/deregistration delay temporarily.
sarah: Can we do a quick fix that doesn't require infra API changes? Maybe relax readiness probe timeout on the deployment for the GPU pool while we stabilize?
miguel: I tried `kubectl patch` to bump timeoutSeconds from 1 to 3 for the deployed container readiness probe on the ai-inference daemonset in the gpu-pool. Command used:
```
kubectl -n inference patch daemonset ai-inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe/httpGet/timeoutSeconds","value":3}]'
```

miguel: After patch, immediate drop rate slowed, ALB started re-registering targets. Not a long-term fix but buys room. :thumbsup:
elaine: I'm going to escalate to networking to expand ephemeral port range and lift conntrack limits for that nodegroup. Opening ticket: NET-1027.
raj: We should also look at moving ALB healthchecks to use the node port (host IP) for those pods or put a small health-check proxy on host to avoid SNAT for probe traffic. Host-based health proxy would bypass NAT and be robust.
oncall-marc: Good idea. Can we also enable the ALB target group attribute `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds` to 120s so brief spikes don't evict targets? That can be applied via terraform but we can patch manually in console for emergency.
sarah: Please add a note to the runbook: if SNAT exhaustion is suspected, do not immediately reapply deployments; increase readiness timeout and/or adjust ALB thresholds first.
miguel: Logged short postmortem draft and action items in docs: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/NET-1027 (includes commands we ran, timeline, and mitigation steps).
elaine: Action items: 1) expand ephemeral port range on GPU node AMI (NET-1027), 2) host-based health proxy PoC for ALB checks (ENG-1789), 3) terraform change to set longer deregistration_delay for gpu-target-group, 4) monitoring alert for conntrack_utilization > 0.85.
raj: I'll pick up the host-proxy PoC tomorrow.
miguel: Thanks everyone, will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
